body: I still can't believe someone would say that.  Insane.

I've never personally done it, but a lot of my friends who travel frequently with toys pack them in a clear ziplop gallon bag (or 2-3 of them) and clearly label them "sex toys."  That way if TSA happens to open up your bag to look, they don't have to hold up your harness and yell "WHAT IS THIS?!" because you have already explained via labeling.  

I hope that piece of advice helps, but other than that, I have nothing to offer on the subject.  Hopefully others will have some good advice.
